theorem: Fixing every off-diagonal graph inequality at its lower endpoint exposes a twelve-dimensional face of the complete lift fiber. It is affinely the nonnegative orthant, hence has 2^12 faces, one vertex A, and rays E_ii.  Since the strict graph is connected, x*(A+Diag(t))x=0 implies x is constant and every supported t_i x_i^2 vanishes. Thus every nonzero t makes the block positive definite. Consequently this face contains no nontrivial low-rank stratum beyond its rank-eleven vertex.
